subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on July 15th, 2022, at 10:00 AM. Your seat is reserved in Economy Class, seat number 22A. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before the flight. If you have any questions or need to make changes to your booking, please contact our customer support team. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
